The existing exact directed-Steiner DP is the strongest part of the implementation because it charges each shared link once and naturally chooses relay clouds that reduce duplicated egress. The main opportunity is that the current hard cutoff unnecessarily switches a 14-destination broadcast to a greedy approximation.

Increasing the exact cutoff to 14 can improve total transfer cost for configurations with 14 unique non-source receivers, while retaining the existing scalable fallback for larger fan-outs. The revised docstring is also more concise while precisely describing the two execution modes.
